# gitmoap_repository_release (Resource)

Creates a release on a tag. When the tag does not exist yet, name a target — a branch, a tag or a commit — and the tag is created there in the same request.

The token needs `release:create`, `release:read`, `release:update` and `release:delete`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name

### Optional

- `body` (String)
- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the release is an unpublished draft, visible only to people with Developer access or
above.
- `name` (String)
- `prerelease` (Boolean) Whether the release is marked as a pre-release. A pre-release is never returned as the latest
release.
- `target` (String)

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) The release's files. Included when a single release is fetched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `author` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--author))
- `commit_sha` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `published_at` (String) Set when the release leaves draft.
- `repository_id` (String)
- `tarball_url` (String) Where to download the tagged source as a `.tar.gz` archive.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number) Increases with every change. Send it with an update so that a change made since you read the
release is not overwritten.
- `zipball_url` (String) Where to download the tagged source as a `.zip` archive.

<a id="nestedatt--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets`

Read-Only:

- `asset_id` (String)
- `content_type` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `download_url` (String) Where to download the file.
- `name` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `state` (String) Whether a release file has been uploaded: `uploading` (an upload URL was issued, but the upload
has not been confirmed yet) or `available`.
- `tag_name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `uploader` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets--uploader))

<a id="nestedatt--assets--uploader"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets.uploader`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and tag_name, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_release.example "<repo_id>/<tag_name>"
```
